title: The Long-Run Effects of Federal Budget Deficits on National Saving and Private Domestic Investment (Working Paper 2014-02)
note: The basis for CBO's rule of thumb that each dollar of additional deficits reduces private investment by about 33 cents (a likely range of 15 to 50 cents).

title: The Macroeconomic and Budgetary Effects of Federal Investment (June 2016)
note: CBO's central estimate that federal nondefense investment (infrastructure, education, and research) earns an average return of about 5 percent, half the typical return on private investment. Mission 2.4's bridge uses it as a rule of thumb.

title: Introduction to the Federal Budget Process (R46240), updated January 10, 2023
note: The basis for missions 1.3 (Paying the bills), 2.2 (Who's who), 2.4 (Rules of the road) and 3.3 (Brakes and the debt limit): budget authority, obligations and outlays; the Antideficiency Act; the President's budget and the congressional timetable; the budget resolution, points of order and reconciliation; Statutory PAYGO, sequestration, the debt limit and what is on or off budget. Games that practice a rule with a made-up example say so.
